tools.name: usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf

description.name: web_fetch
description.description: Retrieve content from a public HTTPS document under robots.txt, SSRF and byte limits. Use for a source fetch; choose web_extract when only human-visible text is needed and web_monitor for content change hashes. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API

description.name: web_extract
description.description: Extract human-visible text from one public HTTPS page under robots and size limits. Use for readable page text, not raw document fetching (web_fetch) or SHA256 change detection (web_monitor). This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled ba

description.name: web_monitor
description.description: Measure a public HTTPS page's content hash, optionally comparing the previous SHA256 supplied by the caller. Use for detecting changes; choose web_fetch to retrieve the document or web_extract for just visible text. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Beare

description.name: pdf_to_text
description.description: Extract embedded selectable text from a PDF supplied as base64. Use for text-layer PDFs; use document_ocr when pages are scanned images, and invoice_extract for structured invoice fields. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled backen

description.name: document_ocr
description.description: Apply optical character recognition to a scanned document supplied as base64 and return searchable extracted text. description.name: invoice_extract
description.description: Extract structured invoice fields from one uploaded document, with source page count verified and a per-page cost quote. Use for invoice metadata, not generic OCR (document_ocr) or plain selectable text (pdf_to_text). This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bea

description.name: audio_transcribe

This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API key, an enabled backend operation and an accepted payme

description.name: pdf_split
description.description: Select one-based page numbers from an uploaded PDF and return a new document containing those pages. Use to extract pages; use pdf_merge to concatenate two to five whole PDFs or pdf_to_text for reading text. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Bearer API ke

description.name: pdf_merge
description.description: Combine two to five uploaded base64-encoded PDF documents into one output document, preserving the supplied order. Use to concatenate files; use pdf_split to select pages from one PDF or pdf_to_text to extract text. This is a separately authenticated company Agent Tools relay; requires a valid Beare

description.name: skavio_agent_job_status
description.description: Read your owned processing job and result manifest; no new payment. Input is your original idempotency key. Returns state, reservation, availability and any owned result IDs; only available results may be downloaded.

description.name: skavio_agent_job_result
description.description: Download your owned completed processing result as base64 with SHA256; no new payment. Input result_id must come from your completed owned manifest. Returns data_base64, sha256 and delivered=true, or an explicit error; independently verify the checksum.

description.name: skavio_agent_wallet
description.description: Read your authoritative shared credit wallet; no new payment. Returns balance_credits, available_credits, reserved_credits and USD display strings with ledger_source. It does not fund, reserve, move or spend credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_dns_tls_audit · Private data: verify_native_usdc, match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit, web_fetch, web_extract, web_monitor, pdf_to_text, document_ocr, invoice_extract, audio_transcribe, pdf_split, pdf_merge, skavio_agent_wallet · Public sink: match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_dns_tls_audit · Private data: verify_native_usdc, match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit, web_fetch, web_extract, web_monitor, pdf_to_text, document_ocr, invoice_extract, audio_transcribe, pdf_split, pdf_merge, skavio_agent_wallet · Public sink: match_native_usdc_payment, domain_dns_tls_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "skavio_launch_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free production availability status, including explicitly disabled processing functions. No execution or charge." → after: "Free production availability status, including explicitly disabled processing functions. No execution or charge. Returns activation and owner-funded historical payment journal evidence separately from approved pricing and unverified realized profitability."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
